title: Impresso Text Embedding Request
description: Body of a request to the Impresso Text Embedding endpoint

searchTarget.description: Which embedding space the embedding is going to be used in

model.description: Embedding model to use. Must be compatible with `searchTarget`: `multimodal` supports `openclip-768` (default) and `siglip2-768`; `text` supports only the text embedding model configured on the server (default). When not provided, the default model for the `searchTarget` is used.
